blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) urged the youth to take an active role in protecting their health, conserving natural resources, and supporting their communities as the country braces for a very strong El Niño that is expected to bring prolonged dry conditions through the first half of 2027. During the 7th Camp-Hike-Plant activity held from October 27-29 in the town of Majayjay in Laguna, Czarina Maria Escandor, chief of the DENR Calabarzon Regional Strategic Communication and Initiatives Group (RSCIG), reminded youth participants that the effects of El Niño go beyond rising temperatures.
